items.title: Trump demands 'unconditional surrender' from Iran, as US and Israel intensify strikes
items.description: The Israel military claims to be targeting "Hezbollah infrastructure" in the southern parts of the Lebanese capital — referred to as Dahiyeh.

items.title: Live: Iran war could end in 4 to 6 weeks, White House says
items.description: Follow live.

items.title: ADF helicopter forced to take evasive action during interaction with Chinese aircraft
items.description: The Australian Defence Force says a Seahawk helicopter launched from the Australian frigate HMAS Toowoomba was confronted by a Chinese helicopter and was forced to "take evasion to maintain a safe flight".

items.title: 'A shock to me': Jackie O denies quitting radio show
items.description: Jackie "O" Henderson has denied she quit her hit KIIS FM radio show she hosted with Kyle Sandilands, saying she was left in "shock" by the news.

items.title: Trump hints at which country he may focus on next after Iran war
items.description: Almost a week into the war being waged by the US and Israel on Iran, Donald Trump hints that Cuba could become his next focus.

items.title: Major flooding in Katherine as river 'rising rapidly'
items.description: Katherine residents went to sleep last night with predictions the town's river wouldn't even reach minor levels, and woke up this morning to a major  flood emergency, with water "rising rapidly" this afternoon.

items.title: The hidden forces driving Trump's attack on Iran
items.description: For all the chaos, the terror and the loss of life in the past week following America's war on Iran, oil prices have managed to maintain a semblance of stability.

items.title: Broncos crash back to earth as Panthers get revenge in NRL opener
items.description: The Panthers remind the NRL of their brilliance with a ruthless 26-0 win over premiers Brisbane to kick off their 2026 season, exacting revenge for last year's epic preliminary final loss at Lang Park.

items.title: Petracca supreme as Suns demolish Cats in red-hot start to AFL season
items.description: Gold Coast have lived up to big expectations at Carrara, with Christian Petracca and Bailey Humphrey starring in a win over last year's grand finalists Geelong by nearly 10 goals. Follow live.

items.title: 'Heartbreaking loss': Missing surf lifesaver found dead on Sunshine Coast
items.description: The alarm was raised when the 18-year-old failed to return to the beach on Wednesday, setting off a major search operation.

items.title: F1 team in 'scary place' as risk of missing Melbourne GP grows
items.description: Aston Martin is running the risk of not being able to participate in Sunday's Australian Grand Prix, at least, as issues grow for the beleaguered team.

items.title: Woman who put holes in friend's condoms found not guilty of intent to harm
items.description: A Bunbury woman has been found not guilty of intent to cause harm after she admitted to tampering with her housemate's condoms while she was in a "fit of rage".

items.title: Noem's firing proves loyalty doesn't make you untouchable
items.description: Kristi Noem discovers that loyalty alone doesn't make you untouchable, becoming the first cabinet secretary to be fired in Donald Trump's second administration.

items.title: Shown pornographic images, asked for threesomes: SES women's claims of sexism
items.description: A review into SES member experiences hears allegations of sexual harassment, stalking and pockets of "boys' clubs" operating throughout the state.

items.title: Alyssa Healy falls cheaply under lights late on first day of final Test
items.description: Australia captain Alyssa Healy falls for 13 in the first innings of her final Test, as 13 wickets fall on day one of the day-night Test against India at the WACA.

items.title: From a hilarious novel to a stellar charity album — we have your weekend covered
items.description: From a laugh-out-loud novel to classic TV for adults and kids, there's plenty of culture to dig into this weekend.

items.title: Pygmy possum with long fingers rediscovered in remote rainforest
items.description: A possum and a glider long thought extinct have been rediscovered in New Guinea by a group including Australian mammalogist Tim Flannery.

items.title: Hundreds of jobs at risk as Tahmoor mine ordered into liquidation
items.description: A Supreme Court judge approves a winding-up order for the embattled Tahmoor mine, owned by billionaire Sanjeev Gupta.

items.title: How a popular beauty routine may put workers at risk
items.description: Walk-in nail salons are a mainstay of shopping hubs across Australia, but not enough is known about the health problems nail technicians face. Experts say it is time that changed.

items.title: Man ramped in his final hours added to 'lack of dignity', partner says
items.description: An Adelaide man spent some of his final moments stuck in an ambulance outside a major Adelaide public hospital, his partner says.

items.title: New Epstein files reveal an unconfirmed, alleged attempted sexual assault by Trump
items.description: The Justice Department releases additional Jeffrey Epstein files involving uncorroborated accusations made by a woman against US President Donald Trump that the department said had been mistakenly withheld during an earlier review.

items.title: Plucky Bangladesh teases Asian Cup contest as North Korea, China advance
items.description: For 45 minutes, minnows Bangladesh pushed North Korea all the way. It was a breath of fresh air for a tournament desperately lacking close matches.

items.title: Aussie Rules official heard describing women as 'breeders'
items.description: A southern NSW football club says an official has stepped down after making derogatory comments about players on its women's team.

items.title: 'Justice won’t be done': Death in custody findings released
items.description: The inquest heard that Greg Merriman had a heart attack and died alone in his locked cell after tear gas was deployed by Corrective Services officers in his prison wing.

items.title: West Melbourne mosque closed after reports of suspicious package
items.description: A mosque in West Melbourne has temporarily closed while police investigate reports of a suspicious package.
